LESSON: PHONOLOGICAL SPEAKING

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Phonological SPEAKING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Phonological SPEAKING. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recognize and say multiple 4 lessons syllables and words
2. blend and segment syllables correctly to form words.
3. use appropriate words to make short, meaningful sentences
4. appreciate the role of blending and segmenting in forming sentences

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. recognize and say multiple 4 lessons syllables and words
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recognize and say multiple 4 lessons syllables and words. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. blend and segment syllables correctly to form words.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to blend and segment syllables correctly to form words. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. use appropriate words to make short, meaningful sentences
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use appropriate words to make short, meaningful sentences. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. appreciate the role of blending and segmenting in forming sentences
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the role of blending and segmenting in forming sentences. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Phonological SPEAKING.
2. Explain Phonological SPEAKING to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Phonological SPEAKING.
4. Show that you can: recognize and say multiple 4 lessons syllables and words
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Phonological SPEAKING. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Phonological SPEAKING important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. recognize and say multiple 4 lessons syllables and words
2. blend and segment syllables correctly to form words.
3. use appropriate words to make short, meaningful sentences
4. appreciate the role of blending and segmenting in forming sentences

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
